item.title: Broken Moon #1
item.description: When explosions on the moon rock the surface of the Earth, humans are all but wiped out - allowing monsters of legend to rise and take control of civilization. Vampires, with their polluted cities and human factory-farming, have thus far come out on top - but if the werewolves have anything to say about it, the vampires’ reign won’t last for long…

item.title: Broken Moon #2
item.description: Humans David and Avery only narrowly escape a vampire attack with their lives, thanks to the unexpected aid of… a pack of werewolves? Werewolf leader Rantz has decided to stop hunting humans due to their shared vampire enemy. But even working together, they’re vastly outnumbered. To seek out help, Rantz relies on the ancient tale of a madman – one they called .

item.title: Broken Moon #3
item.description: In dire need of an army, werewolves and humans searched for Frankenstein - and found him… in a city alongside scores of other patchwork people he’s sewn up along the way. But this mad, broken doctor is only interested in experimenting - quite possibly on Rantz’s and Avery’s friends - and it will take a dangerous journey to the Vampire City to convince him that the destruction of the world is at hand.
